summary: Frontend-only testing of new /platform route, interactive Ecosystem experience, branch filter, nav routing, mobile menu, and contact form. All 11 targeted flows passed. No console errors except a minor Radix a11y warning about missing DialogTitle on the mobile Sheet.

issues: Radix DialogContent (SheetContent) missing accessible DialogTitle — a11y console warning. Wrap a hidden title with VisuallyHidden inside SheetContent.

action_items: Optional a11y fix: add a VisuallyHidden <SheetTitle> inside mobile SheetContent to silence Radix Dialog warning.
critical_code_review_comments: EcosystemExperience: node buttons use onMouseEnter to change selection — works on desktop, fine on mobile via onClick. OK.
Icon import via Icons[p.icon] relies on lucide-react naming; all names in PLATFORMS resolve correctly at runtime (no console errors).
ScrollManager: uses setTimeout(80ms) for hash scroll — works reliably in tests, but consider requestAnimationFrame + retry if target renders lazily.
METRICS_NOW still says '9 Integrated platforms' but new copy talks about 13 — content drift worth aligning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: nav-link-platform, ecosystem-experience with 3 branches + ANCR hub + 12 modules, hover/click updates ecosystem-detail (Vaulta/ANCR verified), branch-careers filter dims non-career nodes to opacity 0.32 and resets on second click, ecosystem-explore-btn -> /platform, /platform renders platform-hero, branch-platform-* items, and its own ecosystem-experience. Cross-page hash nav (Platform -> nav-link-challenge) scrolls to #challenge on home. brand-logo returns to /. Mobile 390px: mobile-menu-trigger -> mobile-nav-link-platform navigates to /platform; node clicks work. Contact form: invalid email shows error toast, valid partner@university.edu shows success toast and clears input. No broken images, no console errors.
